svg.text: The desktop stays usable while it serves
8 GB of RAM, 13 of 16 CPU threads and the GPU's reserve are left over:
a browser with a video, a Discord or Teams call and the usual desktop
run alongside it without touching the token rate.

g.text: 1. Expert slices read at their natural 0.6–1.2 MB size over io_uring/O_DIRECT — 23× the bandwidth of 4 KiB demand paging on the same NVMe.
2. Three-tier expert cache: VRAM (6.3 GB, ~2,021 experts), 12 GB pinned RAM, NVMe — 95% of lookups hit, 82% served from VRAM.
3. VRAM-resident experts computed inside each layer's replayed CUDA graph; residency looked up on the device, no host round trip.
4. Next-layer routing predicted from the residual and prefetched while the current layer computes; only the reads a token needs are waited for.
5. Decode attention flat at any context: sparse attention over pooled block keys — the same 0.55 ms per layer at 4K and at 160K.
6. Layer-major prefill streams each layer's experts in 16 MB chunks into VRAM and sweeps the whole batch; the tier lends it the memory and takes it back.
7. OpenAI-compatible server (streaming, tool calling, thinking budget, live stats) and a console with hardware-aware settings from a fitted cost model.

svg.text: Q3_K_XL is faster because its expert blocks are 42% smaller: every gigabyte of VRAM holds 30% more experts and every miss reads less. Q4_K_XL is the quality choice.
llama.cpp Q4 rows: Unsloth Studio's llama-server as the Studio launches it, same prompts, its own timings. Its prefill is page-fault bound (158 MB/s off the NVMe, GPU 15–30% busy), so the
117K document was stopped after 4,096 tokens and its grounded decode was measured over a 4K-token document instead. The llama.cpp Q3 figure is from an earlier session (mmap, long context).

Built on ggml (quantized kernels, CUDA backend) and llama.cpp's tokenizer; the graph, memory hierarchy, cache, prefill, server and console are the engine's own. Forward pass validated bit-exact against llama.cpp.
GPU decode is nondeterministic run to run; numbers are single measured runs on the same machine, same checkpoints, same settings.
